passages.text: In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me; and there the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel was a prophet of God.
In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I sat in my house.
The elders of Judah sat before me.
The hand of the Lord GOD came upon me there.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֗ית בַּשִּׁשִּׁי֙ בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ אֲנִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּבֵיתִ֔י וְזִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יוֹשְׁבִ֣ים לְפָנָ֑י וַתִּפֹּ֤ל עָלַי֙ שָׁ֔ם יַ֖ד אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃

passages.text: Then I looked and saw a figure like that of a man. From His waist down His appearance was like fire, and from His waist up He was as bright as the gleam of amber.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel was a prophet of God.
He was sitting in his house.
The elders of Judah were sitting before him.
The hand of the Lord GOD came upon Ezekiel.
Ezekiel looked up.
He saw a figure that looked like a man.
From the waist down, the figure looked like fire.
From the waist up, the figure shone brightly.
The upper part was as bright as glowing amber.
passages.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה דְמוּת֙ כְּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֔שׁ מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה מָתְנָ֛יו וּלְמַ֖טָּה אֵ֑שׁ וּמִמָּתְנָ֣יו וּלְמַ֔עְלָה כְּמַרְאֵה־ זֹ֖הַר כְּעֵ֥ין הַחַשְׁמַֽלָה׃

passages.text: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. Then the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and carried me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes jealousy was seated.
passages.sermon:
God appeared to Ezekiel in a vision.
God stretched out something that looked like a hand.
God took Ezekiel by the hair of his head.
The Spirit lifted Ezekiel up.
The Spirit placed Ezekiel between earth and heaven.
The Spirit carried Ezekiel in visions from God.
The Spirit brought Ezekiel to Jerusalem.
The Spirit brought Ezekiel to the entrance of the inner court's north gate.
An idol that provokes God's jealousy stood at that entrance.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ תַּבְנִ֣ית יָ֔ד וַיִּקָּחֵ֖נִי בְּצִיצִ֣ת רֹאשִׁ֑י וַתִּשָּׂ֣א אֹתִ֣י ר֣וּחַ׀ בֵּֽין־ הָאָ֣רֶץ וּבֵ֣ין הַשָּׁמַ֡יִם וַתָּבֵא֩ אֹתִ֨י יְרוּשָׁלְַ֜מָה בְּמַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־ פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר הַפְּנִימִית֙ הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה צָפ֔וֹנָה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֣ם מוֹשַׁ֔ב סֵ֖מֶל הַקִּנְאָ֥ה הַמַּקְנֶֽה׃

passages.text: And there I saw the glory of the God of Israel, like the vision I had seen in the plain.
passages.sermon: I saw the glory of the God of Israel there.\r\nThe glory looked like the vision I saw in the plain.
passages.original: וְהִ֨נֵּה־ שָׁ֔ם כְּב֖וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּמַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי בַּבִּקְעָֽה׃

passages.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “now lift up your eyes to the north.” So I lifted up my eyes to the north, and in the entrance north of the Altar Gate I saw this idol of jealousy.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
God told me to look up.
He told me to look toward the north.
I lifted my eyes to the north.
I saw the entrance north of the Altar Gate.
I saw an idol there.
This idol caused jealousy.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שָׂא־ נָ֥א עֵינֶ֖יךָ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צָפ֑וֹנָה וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צָפ֔וֹנָה וְהִנֵּ֤ה מִצָּפוֹן֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ סֵ֛מֶל הַקִּנְאָ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה בַּבִּאָֽה׃

passages.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what they are doing—the great abominations that the house of Israel is committing—to drive Me far from My sanctuary? Yet you will see even greater abominations.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me “son of man.”
God asked me a question.
He said, “Do you see what they are doing?”
The people of Israel are doing great abominations here.
They do these things to drive Me far away from My sanctuary.
God told me I would see even greater abominations.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הֲרֹאֶ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה מֵהֶם עֹשִׂ֑ים תּוֹעֵב֨וֹת גְּדֹל֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל׀ עֹשִׂ֣ים פֹּ֗ה לְרָֽחֳקָה֙ מֵעַ֣ל מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וְעוֹד֙ תָּשׁ֣וּב תִּרְאֶ֔ה תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: Then He brought me to the entrance to the court, and I looked and saw a hole in the wall.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God led Ezekiel to the entrance of the courtyard.
Ezekiel looked at the wall.
Ezekiel saw a hole in the wall.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖י אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֑ר וָאֶרְאֶ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֹר־ אֶחָ֖ד בַּקִּֽיר׃

passages.text: “Son of man,” He told me, “dig through the wall.” So I dug through the wall and discovered a doorway.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me “son of man.”
God told me to dig through the wall.
I dug through the wall.
I found a doorway.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֖ם חֲתָר־ נָ֣א בַקִּ֑יר וָאֶחְתֹּ֣ר בַּקִּ֔יר וְהִנֵּ֖ה פֶּ֥תַח אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Then He said to me, “Go in and see the wicked abominations they are committing here.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
God called me “son of man.”
God told me to go inside.
God told me to look.
God said, “See the evil things they are doing here.”
God said, “See the wicked abominations they commit in this place.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֹּ֤א וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־ הַתּוֹעֵב֣וֹת הָרָע֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם עֹשִׂ֖ים פֹּֽה׃

passages.text: So I went in and looked, and engraved all around the wall was every kind of crawling creature and detestable beast, along with all the idols of the house of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel was a prophet.
God sent Ezekiel to see hidden things in the temple.
Ezekiel entered the room.
He looked at the walls.
He saw engravings on every side of the wall.
The engravings showed every kind of crawling creature.
The engravings showed detestable beasts.
The engravings showed all the idols of the house of Israel.
passages.original: וָאָבוֹא֮ וָֽאֶרְאֶה֒ וְהִנֵּ֨ה כָל־ תַּבְנִ֜ית רֶ֤מֶשׂ וּבְהֵמָה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶץ וְכָל־ גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מְחֻקֶּ֥ה עַל־ הַקִּ֖יר סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Before them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.
passages.sermon:
Seventy elders from the house of Israel stood together.
Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan, stood among these elders.
Each man held a censer in his hand.
A cloud of incense rose up from the censers.
passages.original: וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֣ישׁ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י בֵֽית־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וְיַאֲזַנְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ שָׁפָ֜ן עֹמֵ֤ד בְּתוֹכָם֙ עֹמְדִ֣ים לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִ֥ישׁ מִקְטַרְתּ֖וֹ בְּיָד֑וֹ וַעֲתַ֥ר עֲנַֽן־ הַקְּטֹ֖רֶת עֹלֶֽה׃

passages.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? For they are saying, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He asked me a question.
He said, "Do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing?"
These elders are leaders of Israel.
They act in secret.
They do these things in the darkness.
Each elder stands in the room of his own carved image.
Each elder worships his own idol.
They say, "The LORD does not see us."
They also say, "The LORD has left the land."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־ אָדָם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר זִקְנֵ֤י בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ אִ֖ישׁ בְּחַדְרֵ֣י מַשְׂכִּית֑וֹ כִּ֣י אֹמְרִ֗ים אֵ֤ין יְהוָה֙ רֹאֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔נוּ עָזַ֥ב יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Again, He told me, “You will see them committing even greater abominations.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He said, “You will see more.”
He said, “You will see greater abominations.”
He said, “They are doing these things.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.
passages.sermon:
The LORD brought me to the entrance of His house.
He took me to the north gate.
I saw women sitting there.
The women were weeping for Tammuz.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗י אֶל־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ שַׁ֣עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶל־ הַצָּפ֑וֹנָה וְהִנֵּה־ שָׁם֙ הַנָּשִׁ֣ים יֹֽשְׁב֔וֹת מְבַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־ הַתַּמּֽוּז׃ס

passages.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Yet you will see even greater abominations than these.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me “son of man.”
He asked me if I saw what was happening.
He told me I would see even greater abominations than these.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֖י הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־ אָדָ֑ם ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: So He brought me to the inner court of the house of the LORD, and there at the entrance to the temple of the LORD, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs to the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east; and they were bowing to the east in worship of the sun.
passages.sermon:
The Lord brought me to the inner court of His house.
I saw the entrance to the temple of the Lord.
This entrance stood between the portico and the altar.
About twenty-five men stood there.
These men turned their backs to the temple of the Lord.
They faced toward the east.
They bowed down to the east.
They worshiped the sun.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗י אֶל־ חֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֮ הַפְּנִימִית֒ וְהִנֵּה־ פֶ֜תַח הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֗ה בֵּ֤ין הָֽאוּלָם֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ אֲחֹ֨רֵיהֶ֜ם אֶל־ הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וּפְנֵיהֶ֣ם קֵ֔דְמָה וְהֵ֛מָּה מִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֥ם קֵ֖דְמָה לַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

passages.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Is it not enough for the house of Judah to commit the abominations they are practicing here, that they must also fill the land with violence and continually provoke Me to anger? Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose!
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me “son of man.”
God asked me a question.
He said, “Do you see this?”
God spoke about the house of Judah.
The house of Judah is the people of Judah.
God said the people of Judah commit abominations here.
Abominations are evil acts against God.
God asked if these abominations are not enough.
God said the people of Judah also fill the land with violence.
They do not stop at evil acts.
They fill the land with violence.
They keep provoking God to anger.
They make God angry again and again.
God said, “Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose.”
This act shows disrespect and rebellion against God.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־ אָדָם֒ הֲנָקֵל֙ לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה מֵעֲשׂ֕וֹת אֶת־ הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשׂוּ־ פֹ֑ה כִּֽי־ מָלְא֨וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֜רֶץ חָמָ֗ס וַיָּשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ לְהַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי וְהִנָּ֛ם שֹׁלְחִ֥ים אֶת־ הַזְּמוֹרָ֖ה אֶל־ אַפָּֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore I will respond with wrath. I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. Although they shout loudly in My ears, I will not listen to them.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke about the people of Judah.
God said He would act in anger.
God said He would not show pity.
God said He would not spare them.
God said they would cry out loudly to Him.
God said He would not listen to them.
passages.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִי֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה בְחֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא־ תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖י וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמֹ֑ל וְקָרְא֤וּ בְאָזְנַי֙ ק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל וְלֹ֥א אֶשְׁמַ֖ע אוֹתָֽם׃
